crossRefs.note: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and…
Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of…
For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

parallels.note: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it…

translations.web: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.
translations.bsb: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.
translations.kjv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt
translations.asv: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
